newsitem.title: USA: Connect sees Q1 earns below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Connect sees Q1 earns below estimates.

text.p: Connect Inc on Wednesday said it expects revenues and operating earnings for its first quarter ended March 31 to fall below analysts estimates.
It expects revenues will range from $2.0 to $2.5 million which "will yield operating results below those expected by securities analysts."
It said lower expenses will only partially offset the shortfall in revenues.
Analysts had forecast a loss of $0.17 a share for the company with a range of estimates from a loss of $0.15 a share to a loss of $0.18 a share, according to First Call.
Connect, a developer of application software for Internet-based commerce, said in a statement it is disappointed in the overall results for the quater.
It also noted the market for high-end electronic commerce remains relatively immature.
Connect said a significant portion of its revenues come from a relatively small number of orders by large companies, making quarter-to-quarter revenue difficult to forecast.
